faq.q1: Do you write in-house or use AI-generated content?
faq.a1: Every piece is written and edited by native-language human writers. We use research tools to speed up fact-finding, but final copy is never raw AI output.
faq.q2: How many articles or posts do I get per month?
faq.a2: Volume is scoped to your plan — from a few in-depth pillar articles to a full weekly blogging cadence. We'll size it to your traffic goals during the consultation.
faq.q3: Do you handle keyword research, or do I provide topics?
faq.a3: We do full keyword and competitor research to find topics with real search demand, though we're happy to incorporate topics you already have in mind.
faq.q4: Is content published directly to my site, or do I review it first?
faq.a4: You review and approve every piece before it goes live — we can also publish directly to your CMS once you're comfortable with the workflow.
